title: The Third Possibility
next_chapter_hook: Beneath the dust of ten thousand years, whose erased name is it? What variables will "the third possibility" from Mo Xiansheng bring to Chen Ji's chess game?

text.content: In the depths of that gaze transcending time and space, a silhouette both achingly familiar and utterly strange flickered in and out of view—it was Mo Xiansheng's form, yet not entirely. His voice carried like destiny itself whispering: "Chen Ji, you've finally reached this point." Chen Ji's entire body shuddered; the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea quivered violently, as if sensing something. He wanted to speak, yet found his voice imprisoned by some force. Mo Xiansheng's phantom slowly raised his hand, and a gentle radiance enveloped Chen Ji—that light bore an uncanny familiarity, the aura of Chen Xuan.

dialogue.content: "Don't be impatient, young man. Do you think this place is some ordinary location? This is a crack in fate, a three-way fork of time." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried profound meaning. "You've seen two possibilities with the Tianji Record, but did you know there exists a third?"

text.content: Chen Ji's heart seized. A third possibility? He'd clearly only witnessed two outcomes—either he died, or Ye Qing perished. Was there some variable he'd failed to perceive? At that moment, the light enveloping him shifted abruptly, revealing within it a slender silhouette. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply; though the figure was blurred, it possessed a familiarity that struck terror into his heart. It was the person he'd been searching for all along—Chen Nian!

dialogue.content: "Brother... brother..." The blurred figure actually spoke, her voice childish yet carrying indescribable emotion. "You found me at last... But I am not your sister Chen Nian. I am Chen Ling, a being created by Chen Xuan using your blood essence and fragments of the Tianji Record. I possess her memories from ten thousand years ago, yet not her fate."

text.content: Chen Ji felt something explode within his mind. Chen Ling? Created from his blood essence? What did that mean? Had his sister Chen Nian never existed in this world? Or was this entity merely an elaborately designed deception? Mo Xiansheng's phantom watched silently from the side, as if awaiting Chen Ji's reaction. Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcing himself to remain calm. True or false, the priority now was obtaining information.

dialogue.content: "You don't believe me?" Chen Ling's voice carried a trace of bitterness. "Indeed, you Chen Ji calculate every possibility—how could you readily trust a 'sister' who appeared out of thin air? But did you know why every vision of me in your Tianji Record is blurred? Because I am not a variable in this world; I am a constant—my existence itself is the act of rewriting fate."

text.content: Chen Ji finally reclaimed his voice, his tone carrying rare trembling: "You claim you're a creation of Chen Xuan using my blood essence... but I've never left Tianqing Sect since birth—when did he take it?"

dialogue.content: "Silence!" Chen Ji lost composure for the first time. "What proof do you have?" Chen Ling's figure suddenly grew clearer, and on that face seven-tenths similar to Chen Ji's, resolute determination appeared: "Proof? Does the roster I witnessed ten thousand years ago at the Holy Sect count? Your name Chen Ji was written there, and beside your name existed an erased name—the name of someone even Heavenly Dao dares not inscribe!"

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's phantom finally reacted, his voice carrying a note of approval: "Chen Ling, you've finally decided to speak the truth." He turned to Chen Ji. "She's right. Chen Nian died ten thousand years ago—slain by Heavenly Dao's hunters. And Chen Xuan, to protect you, fused a strand of your divine consciousness with a Tianji Record fragment before you were even born, creating Chen Ling. Her mission was to guard you until you grew strong enough."

dialogue.content: "But I refuse to accept this!" Chen Ling's voice suddenly blazed with intensity. "I refuse to exist merely as a tool! I possess independent consciousness, I possess the right to choose! I've witnessed the truth from ten thousand years ago—when Chen Xuan created me, he imposed two shackles: the Heavenly Fate Lock Key's seal, and absolute obedience to you. But I chose to break free of the second one!"

text.content: Chen Ji gazed silently at this being who claimed to be his "creation," his heart churning with complex emotions. He recalled his obsession with his sister over these twenty years, the unease stirred by every blurred figure in the Tianji Record. Now that the truth had been unveiled, it was more brutal than any possibility he'd imagined. He hadn't lost a sister—he'd never possessed one—at least, not in the traditional sense.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, I shall ask you one final time." Chen Ling's voice became unprecedentedly serious. "Will you accept me? Not as a sister, not as a tool, but as an independent being with her own will, standing shoulder to shoulder with you in battle? I can help you break Heavenly Eye's surveillance, help you pierce through fate's mists—but the condition is, you must respect my choices."

text.content: Chen Ji stepped back, his expression cold and detached: "Words are empty proof. You claim to be Chen Xuan's creation, claim to possess independent will—why should I believe you? Perhaps this is merely an even more sophisticated deception." Chen Ling's figure dimmed for an instant, but quickly regained its resolve:

Mo Xiansheng observed the scene before him, a glint of approval flickering in his eyes: "Excellent, whatever choice you make, you've passed this trial. But Chen Ling, there is one thing you must tell him now." Chen Ling's figure paused momentarily, then turned to Chen Ji: "The erased name... I can only see its first character—'Yuan.' On the roster Chen Xuan left behind ten thousand years ago, beside your name was written 'Chen Ji·Yuan,' as if you were originally one being, yet artificially severed."

dialogue.content: "Yuan?" Mo Xiansheng's phantom suddenly grew grave. "So you've finally touched that level. Chen Ji, do you know why Ling Yuan has survived to this day? Why he could lurk within Tianqing Sect for millennia without being discovered?" Chen Ji's heart seized; that name rose in his mind—Ling Yuan! Could it be that..."

text.content: Chen Ji's hair stood on end. Ling Yuan, that old Sect Master who appeared to shelter him yet harbored sinister intentions beneath the surface. Could it be that some connection transcending time existed between them? Chen Ling seemed to read his thoughts, her voice soft:
text.我无法确定。但我能告诉你的是——万年前那场浩劫，陈玄与凌渊曾是同门师兄弟，而他们: 间不多了，陈机。记住，命运给你的第三种可能，不是选择，而是创造——创造一个连天道都无法预见的全新变数。"

text.content: The light suddenly dispersed, and Chen Ji forcefully opened his eyes. He still stood at the Cliff Edge of Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, as if everything before had merely been a dream. Yet the unusual warmth radiating from the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea told him it was no dream. Beside him, a illusory figure slowly coalesced into form—Chen Ling. She did not look at him, merely gazing silently at the distant horizon: "From now on, I will stay by your side. Not because of Chen Xuan's command, not because you sought me, but because I choose to do so." A genuine smile finally appeared on Chen Ji's lips: "Welcome to this chess game destined to fail, Chen Ling." Chen Ling turned her head, and that face seven-tenths similar to Chen Ji's finally blazed with light that belonged solely to her: "No, a chess game destined to rewrite fate."
